answer: We define a mechanism where agents commit dynamic opportunity-cost bonds calibrated to a subgame-perfect punishment matrix, ensuring any identity multiplication incurs a penalty exceeding the cumulative reward. By integrating a zero-knowledge verifiable delay as a cryptoeconomic cipher, the protocol forces an adversarial plume of sybil nodes to forfeit their staking collateral against the tide of forced liquidations. This equilibrium forces the expected utility of attack below zero, rendering deviation irrational and achieving a robust Nash equilibrium across all non-cooperative subgames.
